text: On July 26, 2022, the Board of Directors considered the 2021 annual performance of the President. This report provides an update of the President's 2021 performance review and includes an update on the compensation benchmarking review for the President conducted by a third party. The update will require a closed session discussion, as it deals with personal matters about identifiable persons.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Adopted the recommendations and instructions to staff contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 28, 2022) from the Board Chair, Toronto Parking Authority, as amended in closed session. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 28, 2022) from the Board Chair, Toronto Parking Authority, remain confidential in its entirety, as it deals with personal matters about identifiable persons.
